about: R-adf-2 says how often the user signs off follows the regime: once per program when autonomous, at each stage's archive when seam-chained. The user wants how often to be its own choice, so a project can sign off once at the end of a whole program, or at every change, whichever regime it runs in.
question: Should how often the user signs off become its own setting, separate from the regime, which amends R-adf-2?
